key_reasoning.reason: Change spans 4 components across two product areas: ProjectMembersManager (settings/administration), AnalyticsPage + AnalyticsFilters + AnalyticsUserFilter (analytics), plus two new shared utility functions (computeAnalyticsBudgetPeriod, getAnalyticsMemberLink). Shared utilities added warrant L.

Diffstat reports 11 files changed (6 new test files + 5 production files modified/created), mapping to XL (11-15) per the scoring table. Test coverage for edge cases in budget period computation accounts for the majority of the insertion count (969 insertions).

Budget period computation (computeAnalyticsBudgetPeriod) contains custom date math with multiple edge cases: budget_reset_at vs created_at fallback, 30-minute floor-to-step snapping, NaN guards. No existing utility covered this domain. Closest pattern is the analytics filter URL encoding, which is well-established. M is appropriate — novel but low-risk, no security or performance critical path.
